description: This file defines a CKEditor PHP wrapper class that enables embedding and configuring CKEditor instances within PHP web applications. It includes methods for creating editors, replacing textareas, managing events, and generating the necessary JavaScript code.

classes.name: CKEditor
classes.description: A PHP class providing an interface to embed, configure, and control CKEditor instances in server-side PHP pages, with methods for creating editors, replacing textareas, managing events, and generating initialization scripts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for CKEditor class, optionally sets the base path to ckeditor.js.

methods.name: editor
methods.description: Creates a new CKEditor instance with specified name, initial value, configuration, and events.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces an existing textarea element with a CKEditor instance identified by id.

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.description: Replaces all textarea elements or those with a specific class name with CKEditor instances.

methods.name: addEventHandler
methods.description: Adds an event handler for CKEditor events.

methods.name: clearEventHandlers
methods.description: Clears registered event handlers for specific events or all events.

methods.name: addGlobalEventHandler
methods.description: Adds a global event handler for CKEditor global events.
